matching: whole-word exact set intersection; no stemming or synonym expansion
query_term_focus: At least one non-stopword shared between query and exercise question
disjoint_source_context: At least two source intervals after merging overlapping or touching intervals
estimator: Within-request fraction, followed by an unweighted mean over requests, multiplied by 100
fallback_question_policy: Use the saved synthetic question verbatim; no substitution with the real query.
dilution_proxy: 100 minus query-term coverage in percent; zero-overlap exercise fraction
sample: First 15 saved questions of every shared complete request; same source inputs as the existing relevance audit
